notes.title: Craft Craft Craft! - Adding A Clicker Effect And Visual Bug Fix
notes.notes:
* The game now has a clicker effect that shows how many items you have crafted while crafting items.

* Fixed the issue where the Pauldron Tier 3 item was interfering with the visuals of other items as the level increased.

notes.title: Craft Craft Craft! - Craft Improvements And A Few Changes
notes.notes:
* Now, if you want to produce the maximum amount of items while crafting, you can press the [Shift] key to produce the maximum item.

* Collectables from other castles will no longer go on cooldown after receiving collectibles from a single castle in the "Powerful Area". The cooldown of each castle will not be reset until you collect it, and you will be able to recover the loot of all the castles you have conquered.

- Changes are currently only available through beta. To join the beta, right-click on the game in your steam library, select "Features", then choose "join betas". You can enter the beta called "craftbeta".

Dev Says :

I hope you are happy with the changes made. It was really difficult for me to set the maximum craft amounts, it took me a while to add it as it was a feature I had never thought of before. I can't share this update publicly at the moment because the "Save Files" get corrupted when they detect any changes and we cannot access the old save files. If you haven't played the game before, I recommend you to join the beta and try it, it's a feature that will save you a lot of time. It is worth informing that if you have played before and joined the beta, your save files will still be deleted. In the future, when I release this beta as a full version, I will share an update note again. Thank you to everyone who reads, supports, comments and reviews.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Craft Craft Craft! - Balance Updates
notes.notes:
* Gains have been arranged according to difficulty modes, and weapons and armors from t1 to t7 have been made more profitable.

* Increased damage of elements. High quality (tier7) army members will now deal more damage when you have all the elements. This increase includes other tier army members, but tier7 army members have been increased to deal more damage.

* Increased loot from villages and castles. You can now have more loot, both after conquest and in regularly collectible resources.

* The mastery points you can earn from quests have been increased by 2.5 times.

* Added 3 new achievements. To be honest, it can be accessed by purchasing the easy-to-earn Tier 7 Log, Ore, and Fur materials.

Dev Says :

With this update, I now aim to achieve a more comfortable and progressive gameplay, I tried to prepare an update quickly, taking into account a few criticisms. I hope it has been an update that will contribute to your enjoyment of the game.If you have content or an idea that you would like to improve or change, please feel free to share it with me. 

You have to start a new game to benefit from the changes in the update. (I'm not sure if you need to start a new game for Achievements. But for other balance changes, you must start a new game.)

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Craft Craft Craft! - Display Resulotion And Tutorial
notes.notes:
* Now, the necessary buttons have been brought to the "Options" section so that you can play in the game as either windowed or fullscreen.

* In this way, the problem of the game not being full screen when opening the game has been fixed.

* A tutorial showing what to do at the start of the game has been brought.

- When starting the new game, it is enough to activate the tutorial button at the bottom of the difficulty setting.

Dev Says:

I'm sorry to say that the save files have been corrupted. If you have just started the game or want to start but do not know exactly what to do, you can make a quick start by reading the texts in the short tutorial I prepared for you. Don't worry, the tutorial doesn't just consist of texts, I'm telling you how to do it practically. If you want to play the game in different screen modes, fullscreen and windowed settings are also added. I hope that with this update, you can understand the game more easily and enjoy it to the fullest.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Craft Craft Craft! - Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I hope you are all well.

Let me talk about the update details without slowing down ;

* Now, when you press the "Esc" key in Main Country and places where you are not at war, you will be able to easily switch to the Main Country area.

* Now, if you hold down the [SHIFT] key while buying, selling or crafting something from any area, you will be able to buy, sell and craft more than the maximum limit of 250.

Let me explain with a few examples ;

- While processing in the Blacksmith area, you can now processing all your items at once by holding down shift.

- Likewise, while crafting items in the blacksmith area, you can craft 2.500 instead of 250 by holding down the shift key.

- Or, if you hold down the shift key while selling your crafted item in "Town Hall", you can sell all your items at once.

- In Log Shop, Ore Shop and Fur Shop area, you can buy 5,000 items instead of buying 250 items by holding down the shift key, or you can sell all your tools at once.

* Fixed the issue where T1 was displayed when crafting the visual T4 Pant item.

* Fixed the bug where the requested material was incorrect when crafting the T5 Axe.

* Fixed visual bug when leveling up Pauldron T4 item.

I guess no save file was deleted due to the update. I tried to carefully check after each change and when I saw that my own save file was not deleted or I was not getting any errors, I wanted to share the update. I hope your save files are still intact.

With this change, I hope the game has become something you don't hate to click.

If you want to reach me, my discord link is below ;

https://discord.gg/6RZjMMXM5h

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR
